<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex014022026-09-1606-43-12" status="unreviewed">2 pa la lra as dngs ni ranr rje n re bya nges rang la run zhugs las pa'i don yod pas dngos sgra yin te bshes gnyen da la sman pa zhes brjod pa ltar ston smran pa'i mong nas btags pa smong zhes zer pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re rigs ste nyan thos kyi skab du mya na las 'das pa'i ryun la yin la de la zhugs pa der 'jog pa myid pa yin
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N004"/>
pa ltar rgyas kyi rgun laM ma zhugs pas der 'jog pa'ang dngos sgrar rigs pa'i phyir ||</seg></TEI>
